comment: Screenshot spec. One entry per image. See screenshots/README.md.

shots.caption: The plugin screen at Tools > Email Check: status, settings, and the result log.
shots.alt: The Email Check screen in wp-admin with status, settings and a table of recent results.

shots.caption: The notice in wp-admin when a check fails, with a link to decode the error.
shots.alt: A red admin notice on the Dashboard: Email check failed, with the SMTP error and links.

shots.caption: The notice when scheduled checks have stopped running.
shots.alt: A yellow admin notice on the Dashboard: Email checks have stopped, with a WP-Cron note and links.

shots.caption: Status and settings on the Email Check screen.
shots.alt: Last check passed, daily schedule, recipient field, schedule choice and a Slack webhook URL.

shots.caption: The result log: passing checks, and a failure with its SMTP error.
shots.alt: A table of recent results. Two rows failed with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate; the rest passed.

shots.caption: The notice when a check fails.
shots.alt: Admin notice: Email check failed, with the error text and links to the error page, the results and Dismiss.

shots.caption: The notice when scheduled checks have stopped.
shots.alt: Admin notice: Email checks have stopped, with a DISABLE_WP_CRON note and links.

shots.caption: Overview: the notice on the Dashboard when a check fails.
shots.alt: The WordPress Dashboard with a red notice: Email check failed, the SMTP error, and links to the error page, the results and Dismiss.

shots.caption: Overview: the result log with a failure and the recovery.
shots.alt: A table of recent results: daily checks passed, two failed with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate, then a manual check passed and daily checks passed again.

shots.caption: Overview: the webhook alert in a chat app, for a failure and the recovery.
shots.alt: A chat channel with two messages from Email Check: Email check failed on the site with SMTP Error: Could not authenticate, then Email check passed again.
